rationale: Pi-hole persists in roughly 60 seconds and observer polls every 15 seconds. The collector has a 2-second drain budget for each 500-record batch; a 100 ms/100-domain criterion was not tied to this workload. Use the directly measured 500-name batch.
limitations: No family-labelled dataset; test assesses held-out labels from same source.
Full Pi-hole observer and dashboard DNS overhead still need a controlled comparison.
Home-network alert burden needs a separate observation period.
